title: The Lighthouse Keepers Who Vanished
hook: Three men vanished from a locked lighthouse — and the log book made it worse.
beats: In 1900, a relief boat reached the Flannan Isles lighthouse off Scotland.
The lamp was out. The door was shut. All three keepers were gone.
Inside, a meal sat unfinished and a chair lay knocked over.
The log described a storm so violent one man was found weeping — yet the sea outside had been calm.
payoff: No storm was ever recorded that week. The keepers were never found.
loop_line: So what were they writing about?
